startup.name: Rainbrand
startup.description:
Rainbrand is the brand layer for agents. It turns a brand’s identity, guidance, and assets into shared context that agents and products can use. That context evolves with the brand, alongside the tools where it is created and managed.

Starting with websites, social media, and files, Rainbrand develops and maintains versioned brand context. Through MCP or the API, connected agents and products can retrieve and update that context, then apply it to images, websites, slides, video, copy, and other brand work.

We’re an ai infra company making brand as operable as software.

yc_acceptance.basis: Roughly 1 percent base rate. Conditional on acceptance this is a note: a three person team in a trendy agent infrastructure area, but an unclear buyer.
yc_acceptance.why_it_fails: YC would most plausibly worry that brand guidelines are a feature that design platforms and agent platforms will add, and that the buyer and budget are unclear. The estimate leans on the cohort base rates in stage_benchmarks.md, where later rounds are rare and slow, and on what happened to comparable YC companies such as credal-ai and airweave.

competition_now.name: Typeface MCP
competition_now.what: Brand kits and context via MCP.

technical_complexity.rationale: Crawling brand identity from websites and files and serving versioned context through MCP is buildable by a small team. The hard part is quality and keeping context current across tools.

takeover_risk.rationale: Incumbents already ship similar MCP servers and could add versioning quickly. The timeline is an estimate for a well resourced rival with existing distribution and an incentive to copy the idea.

evidence.claim: Several tools already expose brand guidelines to agents over MCP, suggesting demand exists but is fragmented.
A vendor article argues that governed brand context fits MCP better than a static file.

actions: Ship an MCP server with ten pilot teams.

roadmap.proof: Customers that keep brand data only here.

pros.evidence: Starting with websites, social and files.

brand.name: Rainbrand
brand.name_check: python3 -I scripts/name_features.py --score "Rainbrand" --era 2022+ : one word invented compound.
brand.rationale: The name signals the category and is easy to remember. A brand company needs a good name, but this one is plain rather than distinctive.

narrative.headline: A timely but narrow agent infrastructure idea with small team and feature risk.
narrative.general_summary: Rainbrand offers brand context to agents through MCP. The area is hot but the competition already includes Typeface and small open products. With three people and no named customers, the likeliest path is a small seed, then a hard Series A. Comparable YC context companies mostly stopped at seed. Evidence on budgets is thin. The step odds are anchored on the 2022 to 2025 B2B cohorts and the older 2018 to 2021 cohort, which differ a lot, so treat the later rounds as wide ranges.

assumptions: No customers or founder backgrounds were provided.
